# Version 4.156.0
> **GTK4 GPU and font discovery** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.156.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 Preview 1 introduces GTK4 GPU rendering and restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery.

## Breaking Changes

- **Use physical pixels or opt into logical GTK4 coordinates** — GTK4 SKDrawingArea now allocates high-density backing at physical resolution; CanvasSize and paint Info default to physical pixels. Set IgnorePixelScaling=true for logical paint coordinates while RawInfo retains physical dimensions. GTK input coordinates remain logical. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))
- **Retarget Tizen applications to Tizen 10** — New Tizen native builds and packages require Tizen 10 and support x64/arm64 only. NativeAssets target net10.0-tizen10.0, and source builds require GCC 14.2. Retarget applications and deploy to Tizen 10 rather than using these assets on Tizen 8 or 9. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Engine

- **Skia m156** — Updates the engine to milestone 156 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.100 distinguishes the milestone while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0. ([#5247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5247))

## API Surface

- **Native GTK4 GPU views** — Adds SKGLArea with PaintSurface, CanvasSize, GRContext, an opt-in render loop, and IgnorePixelScaling. GTK owns the GL context; manually bundled GTK runtimes must include libepoxy for GL dispatch. ([#5249](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5249))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies font discovery** — Restores directory-backed system-font discovery without adding fontconfig. The default directory is /usr/share/fonts unless overridden at native build time; explicitly loaded fonts remain supported. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
- **.NET 11 WebAssembly toolchain selection** — Selects Emscripten 6.0.2 archives for .NET 11 and later, retaining 3.1.34 for .NET 8 and 3.1.56 for .NET 9/10. Aligns both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp source and packaged targets. ([#5306](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5306))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.100

Native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0. This package revision selects Emscripten 6.0.2 for .NET 11 WebAssembly, raises Tizen native packages to Tizen 10, and aligns Windows compiler and Spectre CRT selection.

## Preview 1 (October 12, 2026)

Introduced Skia m156, GTK4 GPU rendering and physical-pixel scaling, and restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery. Aligned .NET 11 WebAssembly assets with Emscripten 6.0.2 and raised Tizen packages to Tizen 10.
